title: Aggregate-analysis owner release

scope.rationale: Aggregate rewrite and analysis now have a source-shaped destructor for the separately allocated column array, function array, and AggInfo owner.
excluded_responsibilities: Aggregate analysis, register assignment, and query rewrite

dependencies.caller_closure: The helper owns the complete AggInfo allocation topology used by aggregate analysis.

outputs: Column array, function array, and owner released
contracts.ownership: Consumes the complete AggInfo owner; nullable child arrays are accepted.
contracts.state_and_results: Frees children before the parent with no mutation afterward.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Destructor allocates nothing and cannot fail.

representation_differences: The typed function receives AggInfo directly instead of a void pointer cleanup callback argument.

oracle.protocol: Allocate AggInfo with zero and populated child arrays through the connection allocator, release it, and compare allocation cleanup.
internal_observations: child-before-parent free order and zero retained allocations

assurance.oom: Destructor allocates nothing and supports cleanup after partial construction.
assurance.malformed_input: Requires a source-valid non-null owner; child pointers may be null.
assurance.continuation: Caller must not reuse the consumed owner.

independent_review.notes: Focused trace and independent review remain open.

known_blockers: Wire every future heap AggInfo cleanup site and add focused allocator trace.

implementation_spans: AggInfo allocation and child growth helpers
assertions_branches_cleanup: Null children, populated children, and parent release reviewed
upstream_tests: Project aggregate and broad runtime tests
